Tests fd_chkdup false positives, null cases, duplicates, and performance.

# Purpose
This file is a test program for the `fd_chkdup` duplicate-checking API. It creates random account address arrays and verifies the behavior of `fd_chkdup_check`, `fd_chkdup_check_slow`, and `fd_chkdup_check_fast` against expected false-positive rates, null cases, and forced duplicate cases. The code also measures the average time per transaction for each implementation and compares the results with a table of expected false-positive rates for the active `FD_CHKDUP_IMPL` variant.

The main technical parts are helper functions that build input data with unique 4-byte patterns, run repeated statistical tests, and validate edge cases. [`test_false_positive_rate`](<#test_false_positive_rate>) checks that the observed false-positive count stays within an accepted range, [`test_null`](<#test_null>) checks behavior when zero addresses are inserted, and [`test_duplicates`](<#test_duplicates>) confirms that real duplicates are detected across many index combinations. The [`main`](<#main>) function initializes the runtime, runs all tests, prints timing results, and ends with a pass message if all checks succeed.
